title: Triangle sightings tied to US bases
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Triangle sightings tied to US bases, about late 1990s-2012 at US naval bases; Vandenberg AFB; Langley AFB, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's that famous NID study done in the I think late 90s or early 2000s where they correlate triangle sightings to naval bases in the United States.

place_text: US naval bases; Vandenberg AFB; Langley AFB
